item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. We must prohibit its development before that happens.

2. We reject the gamble of building machines more powerful than humanity. Superintelligent AI built within the next 20 years will cause a catastrophe killing at least a billion people. It must be banned.

3. No company, laboratory, or government has the right to risk a billion lives. We need a legally binding, internationally enforced prohibition on developing superintelligent AI.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We are sounding the alarm because the stakes are absolute: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will cause a catastrophe that kills at least a billion people. No company, government, or laboratory has the right to impose that future on humanity. Promises of voluntary restraint, technical safeguards, or responsible scaling do not meet the danger. We need a legally binding prohibition on developing superintelligence, backed by rigorous monitoring and enforcement across borders. The decisive window is now, before competitive pressure and sunk costs make the race even harder to stop. We can still prevent this catastrophe, but only by choosing survival over the pursuit of machines more powerful than humanity.
